command:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,socket,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/jmagar/workspace/labby/.worktrees/issue-771-server-lifecycle')
git=lambda p,*args: subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),*args],text=True).strip()
base='138ef902dc1842daf883a6e7710b140fbfaf53c0'
gate=root.parent/'issue-771-gate0'
assert socket.gethostname()=='macpoo.local'
assert git(root,'branch','--show-current')=='codex/issue-771-server-lifecycle'
assert git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD')==base
assert git(root,'rev-parse','origin/main')==base
assert git(root,'remote','get-url','origin')=='git@github.com:dinglebear-ai/labby.git'
assert git(gate,'rev-parse','HEAD')=='a5e3f78ca55e52c64b2013a8fae3d26a9bf5819e'
assert git(gate,'rev-parse','HEAD:docs/adr/0007-durable-mcp-task-routing.md')=='3ad75a27b9c46a4ff211cef10365f46057fdaba2'
assert not git(gate,'status','--porcelain')
assert not git(root,'diff','--name-only',base)
owned=('crates/labby-gateway/tests/issue_771_server_lifecycle','docs/tasks/issue-771-server-lifecycle/')
files=git(root,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines()
assert files and all(name.startswith(owned) for name in files)
rules=['AGENTS.md','crates/labby-gateway/AGENTS.md','crates/labby-gateway/src/upstream/AGENTS.md','docs/AGENTS.md']
print(json.dumps({'host':socket.gethostname(),'base':base,'gate0_head':git(gate,'rev-parse','HEAD'),'gate0_clean':True,'production_changes':[],'owned_untracked_count':len(files),'instructions_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in rules}},indent=2))
